review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 351 retail bytes, 146 instructions, 17 blocks, 25 edges; candidate 17/25, score 1.000.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: Blocks and edges match retail exactly (17/25); the full 17-block lattice was enumerated from the bytes and the emitted body reproduces it, including the three exits.

checks.name: exits
checks.rationale: Ret matches: return 0 at 0x004B10BA on no match; return [esp+0x10] at 0x004B117E on a match; and the noreturn Debug_Error spin at 0x004B110A. All three are present.

checks.name: matching
checks.rationale: Uses the landed retail callee Resource_MatchPrefix (0x004AAD10) with count = strlen(record name), not a port strncmp.

checks.name: copies
checks.rationale: Three strlen+1 unbounded copies in retail's order: alias to destination and to 0x00943A18 on the no-match path; target+name_length to destination and destination to 0x00943A18 on the match path.

checks.name: segment_walk
checks.rationale: Skips `depth` semicolons with the CRT strchr helper, then tests for one more to decide the returned depth+1 versus 0, and copies chars up to ';' or NUL without storing the terminator - the append supplies it.

checks.name: bound_conversion
checks.rationale: The table end is expressed as record >= &g_942330[0x1280] because a port table is not linked at retail's 0x009435B0; the byte arithmetic is identical.

evidence: docs/fidelity/evidence/0x4B1020-provenance-defect.md and section 22 of the evidence sheet
limitations: Retail runtime shows the reader reached 4096+ times with all depth 0 and every output byte-identical to its input alias, because the table keys (INTROSCREEN: etc) never appear as reader inputs; the match branch is therefore STATICALLY derived, not runtime observed.
The 0x00943A18 buffer extent 0x80 is inferred from the next referenced global at 0x00943A98; no instruction states a size and both copies are unbounded, as retail's are.
0x009423C0 handles are read as a separate array because the tree splits them; in retail they are record+0x90 and consolidating the two tables is an open structural decision.
